document_title: Project HS Final VFX Production Specification v4 — Runtime Context Compressed

implementation_contract.normative: 이 JSON 하나가 Project HS VFX 재구축의 normative production specification이다. 효과의 visual identity/gameplay geometry/timing/source/output contract를 임의로 변경하지 않는다.
authoring_and_cook: JSON을 schema validation → reference resolution → defaults expansion → typed IR → cooked binary/effect-handle/profile tables 순서로 cook한다.
effect ID 문자열은 authoring/debug/hot-reload용이다. shipped runtime은 uint32 cooked effect_handle을 사용한다.
VisualElement.source.type가 source_type_contracts를 선택하고 outputs[]는 동일 source data를 0..N render outputs로 소비할 수 있다.
unknown backend/behavior/profile/shape/required parameter는 warning이 아니라 cook error다.
stable_seed가 같고 입력 payload가 같으면 stateless random sequence는 deterministic해야 한다.

compression_rules.sharing_rule: top-level library 승격은 단순 사용 횟수가 아니라 semantic identity와 함께 변경되어야 하는지로 결정한다. 3회 이상 재사용은 linter hint일 뿐 hard rule이 아니다.
compression_rules.inline_rule: one-off 또는 의미가 다른 shape/signature 설정은 inline을 허용한다.
compression_rules.default_omission: VisualElement t=[0,1], output min_quality=low, gradient=energy_clean, derived budget_class는 직렬화하지 않는다.
compression_rules.reference_depth: 2 hops preferred; 3 hops allowed when effect output → render profile → shader contract. 4+ hops should fail lint unless explicitly justified.

non_goals: Niagara/Unity VFX Graph와 같은 범용 node editor 또는 runtime graph VM
모든 visual layer를 별도 emitter/runtime object로 만드는 구조
범용 Data Interface/Data Channel reflection DSL
recursive GPU sub-emitter graph가 gameplay 결과를 소유하는 구조
일반-purpose Grid2D/3D fluid solver를 기본 backend로 탑재
MBOIT/sorted translucency를 기본 투명도 경로로 사용
mesh shader/Work Graph/async-compute를 초기 필수 경로로 강제
초기 VFX 구현을 위해 복잡한 placed-resource alias optimizer를 선행 구현
build_order: 2. EventStream/PersistentSnapshot ABI and cooked effect handles
4. render profiles + exact ground SDF + mesh/sprite paths
8. VFX temporal metadata + renderer bloom/temporal integration

reuse: HDR scene path and current bloom/tone-map integration points
existing procedural ring/sector/rune/arrow/flame code where mathematically suitable
replace_or_extend: marker-mesh gameplay telegraph → exact ground SDF
single material path → render profile bins
simple VFX mesh primitives → mesh atlas
render graph logical-only transient resources → real transient resource lifetime
Direct-only graph은 유지 가능하되 compute Dispatch/resource barriers/transient resources를 정상 지원; 별도 async-compute queue는 필수 아님

implementation_contract.texture_rule: texture_asset_contract와 libraries.texture_catalog를 source of truth로 사용한다. 별도 effect-specific PNG는 manifest에 추가하지 않는 한 생성하지 않는다.

compatibility.migration_policy: Migrations happen in cooker, never by silently interpreting old fields at runtime.
from_v3: single VfxSpawnRequest -> VfxEventStream or VfxPersistentSnapshot selected per effect input_mode
global parameter validation -> scoped source/output parameter schemas
render target/pass dependency -> render phase ABI; old pass graph retained only as reference implementation
migration manifest duplicate effect lists removed; only compatibility aliases remain

legacy_aliases.reason: 현재 trap idle은 snapshot persistent state가 pending/armed를 직접 표현하므로 별도 event particle은 이중 표현 가능성이 높음.

VfxEventStream.lifetime_rule: Consumed as a frame-batched event. The effect may use authored fixed dissipation after the event.

VfxPersistentSnapshot.purpose: Authoritative live visuals whose transform/geometry/lifetime must remain synchronized with gameplay/presentation state.
VfxPersistentSnapshot.lifetime_rule: If a stable_id record is absent from the new snapshot, its persistent VFX source stops that frame except explicitly authored cosmetic dissipation tails that cannot imply lingering gameplay danger.

timing_semantics.effect_timing_field: effects[].timing is the authored visual envelope/cycle/dissipation contract, not permission to outlive authoritative gameplay.
timing_semantics.persistent_rule: For input_mode=persistent_snapshot, snapshot presence/state is authoritative for gameplay lifetime. Authored timing may animate within that lifetime and may only continue after removal as a clearly non-dangerous cosmetic tail.
timing_semantics.event_rule: For input_mode=event_stream, effect timing may own its presentation lifetime after the event unless binding timing says otherwise.

direct.purpose: Ground SDF, decal, distortion, light, screen, entity-surface, or one-shot draw data that needs no particle simulation.
direct.extension_rule: New direct output types register a backend/profile; do not introduce graph nodes.

stateless_particle.purpose: High-frequency short particles whose motion can be reconstructed without persistent per-particle state.
stateless_particle.extension_rule: Add a named behavior and typed source schema in C++; unknown behavior is a cook error.

stateful_particle.purpose: Collision, bounce, or genuinely stateful motion that cannot be reconstructed from age+seed.
stateful_particle.extension_rule: Do not use for effects that can use stateless_particle.

owner_follow.purpose: Projectile/entity-attached visual head that must follow authoritative owner motion.
owner_follow.extension_rule: No independent integration of gameplay-owned position.

ribbon_history.purpose: Curved projectile/movement/link trails requiring ordered history and previous-frame vertices.
ribbon_history.extension_rule: History is shared by outputs when one VisualElement has multiple ribbon outputs.

local_volume.purpose: High-tier hero-only bounded raymarched volume; current allowlist is boss spawn/phase change/death/phase2 aura.
local_volume.extension_rule: Ordinary smoke/explosion uses 6-way smoke. Add local volume only after visual/profiling review proves it necessary.

ParticleHot.policy: hot fields only. precise motion이 필요 없는 stateless particle에는 previous_position을 강제하지 않는다.

ParticleColdOptional.policy: effect/profile이 실제 사용하는 경우만 allocation/stream enable.

entity_surface_hook.meaning: Entity material/GBuffer hook for dissolve/shell; participates in scene depth/motion as required.

decal.meaning: Scene-surface projected VFX decal before/with lighting.

lighting_injection.meaning: Append capped VFX local-light records consumed by scene lighting.

distortion.meaning: Accumulate distortion vectors/weight; UI is excluded.

volume.meaning: Bounded hero local volume composited into scene HDR.

screen.meaning: Screen-space damage/low-health/session VFX before UI where specified.

temporal_metadata.meaning: Motion/reactive metadata emitted as a side output of relevant render profiles; temporal resolve itself belongs to renderer.
temporal_metadata.emitted_by_profile_policy: Profiles with temporal.motion_vectors != none or temporal.reactive_mask emit this side-channel; it is not a standalone draw profile.

render_profile_policy.new_profile_rule: 색/강도/texture/shape 차이만으로 새 profile을 만들지 않는다. blend/depth/phase/shader-family 계약이 실제로 달라질 때만 추가한다.

passes.name: VFX Simulate
passes.when: stateful/stateless particle source backends; stateless may bypass persistent state writes

passes.name: Temporal Resolve
passes.quality: high/medium; low may use FXAA fallback

passes.name: Bloom + Tone Map
passes.policy: multi-resolution bloom; gameplay boundary halo clamp

passes.name: Screen VFX + UI
passes.policy: screen damage feedback before UI; UI never distorted

reference_render_pipeline.queue_policy: Direct queue is the normative baseline; compute work is Dispatch on a Direct command list. Async Compute is a later measured optimization, not a prerequisite.
reference_render_pipeline.allocation_policy: Stage 1은 descriptor-keyed transient resource pool을 사용한다. lifetime이 끝난 resource를 다음 frame/compatible pass에서 재사용하되 placed-resource aliasing optimizer는 필수 아님.
reference_render_pipeline.content_dependency_rule: Effect data selects render phases/profiles only; exact pass order/resource names may evolve without rewriting effect recipes.

future_extension_policy.backend_registry: New simulation/render technology is added by registering a typed backend/profile in engine code; existing effect recipes remain valid.

direct.contract: No simulation state. Output consumes effect/binding transform and authored params directly.

requirements: arc_length_uv
miter_or_bevel_join
width_curve
previous_frame_vertices

conventions.authoring_angle_unit: degree unless key explicitly says radians/hz
conventions.color_space: scene-referred linear RGB; authored palette literals are sRGB and converted at load/cook

art_direction.name: Astral Hunter / Runic Ballistics
art_direction.vision_statement: 활과 화살의 물리적 방향성을 최우선으로 유지하면서, 청록·금빛의 정밀한 룬 공학과 고밀도 마력 코어를 결합한다. 적/보스는 적홍·보라의 톱니/균열 언어로 분리한다.

material_language.player: clean luminous energy, crystalline highlights, thin controlled trails
material_language.fire: white-hot core, orange tongues, dark red ember; minimal opaque smoke
material_language.boss: dense emissive core, violet depth, refractive shock, large but clean silhouette

hierarchy.1: idle/basic/frequent; smallest area and lowest HDR
hierarchy.4: high-damage skill / relic proc / dangerous enemy action
hierarchy.5: boss game-changer / death / phase / major explosion

core_rules: gameplay boundary and projectile silhouette are never sacrificed for decoration
primary element remains readable in grayscale
visual impact scales with gameplay impact
directional abilities keep head-tail asymmetry in a frozen frame
persistent danger ends exactly when logic ends
secondary smoke/glow/runes never outshine hitbox boundary or impact point
high-frequency effects use fewer layers; hero effects earn distortion/light/volume

defaults.texture_policy: Use analytic SDF/geometry for simple or gameplay-authoritative shapes; use authored texture arrays for artistic irregular detail; use baked simulation for complex smoke; use shared noise/vector/LUT textures when lookup is cheaper or visually richer than repeated procedural evaluation.

component.lifecycle: component t is normalized within effect timing

timing_phases.dissipation: falls after main; never brighter or more gameplay-salient

defaults.randomness: stable_seed + effect_id + component_id + spawn_index hash; never frame-time random

features: all core render profiles and procedural SDF/ribbon/distortion/decal paths

medium.target: same gameplay clarity with reduced secondary cost

changes: keep exact SDF boundaries and primary projectile heads
disable most distortion except boss telegraph-critical refraction

importance_energy.rule: HDR brightness alone must not communicate quality; importance controls peak energy while shape, motion, material separation, distortion and timing carry polish.
importance_energy.basic_or_low_frequency: basic/high-frequency effects use lower area and peak brightness
importance_energy.boss_game_changer: may use high HDR, local light, distortion, volume when clarity remains intact

quality_policy.hard_rule: quality scaling may remove secondary decoration, but never remove or alter gameplay-bound silhouette/boundary/timing.

frequent.intent: basic attacks, hit/tick/pickup micro VFX. Prefer stateless; no local volume; lights/distortion only when explicitly essential.

standard.intent: normal skills/relics. Full primary read plus selected secondary polish.

persistent.intent: status/area/projectile/trail/telegraph records kept in snapshot. Stable IDs and bounds/culling are mandatory.

hero.intent: boss/game-changing/session climax. May use local volume/light/distortion, but exact gameplay boundary remains independently readable.

budget_policy.profiling_rule: Do not serialize guessed per-effect GPU milliseconds. Tune runtime caps from measured profiles; content spec stores class/importance only.

angle_from_hit.meaning: true면 방향/각도를 hit normal 또는 incoming hit direction에서 계산한다.

anti_alias.meaning: analytic edge AA 방식. 현재 허용값은 fwidth.

center_clear.meaning: 중앙 비어있는 영역의 normalized radius 비율.

chevron_spacing.meaning: 반복 chevron 중심 간 world 간격.

density.meaning: volume/grid density source 또는 opacity density 배율.

domain_warp.meaning: shape radius에 대한 normalized domain-warp 진폭.

drag.meaning: velocity damping 계수. update에서 exp(-drag*dt) 사용.

edge_width.meaning: shape local-space edge width. world bound SDF에는 edge_width_world를 우선한다.

edge_width_world.meaning: gameplay/ground SDF 경계선의 실제 world-space 폭.

flow_speed.meaning: noise/flame/ribbon UV 또는 local pattern flow 속도.

half_res.meaning: true면 해당 volume/screen buffer를 half-resolution으로 계산한다.

head_to_tail_ratio.meaning: 길이 중 밝고 넓은 head가 차지하는 normalized 비율.

noise_warp.meaning: shape radius에 대한 소규모 noise warp 진폭.

radius.meaning: radius authoring parameter. 이 키의 의미를 변경하지 말고 소비 shader/profile 계약에 맞춰 사용한다.

reverse_flow.meaning: 양수면 기본 flow를 반대로 적용하는 배율.

rotation_hz.meaning: 초당 회전 cycle. 음수는 반대 방향.

scroll.meaning: UV/pattern scroll 속도. local UV units/s.

sequence.meaning: true면 요소를 동시에가 아니라 시간 순서대로 발화.

signature_scale.meaning: visual signature primitive에 대한 normalized 배율.

strength.meaning: distortion의 최대 normalized screen UV offset.

taper.meaning: tail/end 폭 비율. 0은 point, 1은 동일 폭.

travel_pulse.meaning: true면 고정 pulse가 아니라 path를 따라 이동하는 pulse.

width_multiplier.meaning: 기준 gameplay/shape 폭에 곱하는 시각적 배율.

spawn_domain.meaning: particle spawn 위치 domain. inside_binding_radius는 effect binding의 gameplay radius 내부 균일 area 분포를 사용한다.

spawn_radius_scale.meaning: binding gameplay radius에 곱하는 spawn domain 반경 배율.

clip_index.meaning: Index into the smoke clip map.

motion_blend.meaning: Quality gate for authored frame motion-vector interpolation; high_only.

player_arcane.identity: 청록-청색 에너지 + 소량의 금빛 사수 악센트. 기본 공격 계층.

player_piercing.identity: 백금/금색 칼날형 코어. 좁고 선명한 관통 언어.

player_multishot.identity: 넓게 퍼지는 황금 부채꼴. 개별 화살 실루엣은 유지.

player_charged.identity: 푸른 백색 고밀도 코어 + 보랏빛 외곽 전하. 충전 단계가 밝기보다 구조로 증가.

player_explosive.identity: 주황/적색 열에너지. 중심은 백열, 외곽은 어두운 연기/파편.

player_ricochet.identity: 구리빛 도탄 에너지 + 점멸성 꺾임. 경로 변화가 shape로 보이게.

player_arrow_rain.identity: 수직 낙하 청색 streak + 금빛 위험 경계. 위→아래 방향성이 핵심.

player_trap.identity: 보라 룬과 청색 기계/마력 선. Pending/Armed는 형태와 회전 방향으로 구분.

player_retreat.identity: 민첩한 청록/청색 운동 에너지. 이동 방향과 잔상이 가장 중요.

enemy.identity: 적 위험은 적홍색이지만 색에만 의존하지 않고 톱니/삼각/해칭 shape 사용.

boss.identity: 보스는 적홍 + 보라 심도, 백색 peak. 일반 적보다 더 큰 shape/value range.

bleed.identity: 액체 방울보다 날카로운 혈흔 shard/절개 shape 중심.

burn.identity: 백열 중심→주황→적갈색 연기. 실제 불꽃 운동.

slow.identity: 냉기색 + 정지/고정 shape. 회전 룬과 짧은 방사형 notch.

mark.identity: 표적 브래킷/눈금. 색보다 명확한 타겟 실루엣.

pickup_xp.identity: 작고 빈번하므로 밝기 절제. 수집 시만 짧은 peak.

relic.identity: 육각/연결 고리/별자리 모티프. proc 종류는 shape로 차별화.

neutral.identity: 범용 물리 충돌/연기. 다른 능력보다 낮은 채도.

boss_area_seal.motion: seal closes then low-frequency active pulse

boss_crest.motion: heavy snap with secondary radial energy

boss_dash_lance.shape: long lance crest + parallel lane edges

boss_shockwave_gap.shape: thick ring with explicit safe-gap cuts

enemy_suicide_saw.shape: toothed warning ring + inward countdown teeth

pickup_relic_hex.motion: slow rotate, open by segment separation

player_arrow_arcane.shape: narrow asymmetric arrowhead + single taper trail

player_arrow_rain.shape: concentric target ring + descending arrow ticks

session_wave_ring.shape: large low-opacity arena ring + directional ticks

arrowhead_mesh.construction: local +Z가 진행 방향인 낮은 폴리곤 arrow/spear head. 뒤쪽이 좁고 앞쪽 tip이 가장 밝다.

bezier_ribbon.construction: 3~4 control point cubic ribbon; history를 따라 부드럽게 연결. Width는 world-space이며 join은 miter, sharp turn은 bevel fallback.

camera_facing_ribbon.construction: history polyline을 camera-facing strip으로 확장. Width는 world-space이며 join은 miter, sharp turn은 bevel fallback.

debris_shard_mesh.construction: 두께가 있는 파편/잔해; local +Z가 장축/진행 방향. mesh atlas에서 선택하며 단순 octahedron으로 대체하지 않는다.

diagonal_hatch.construction: diagonal hatch 반복 패턴. 반복 간격은 world-space이고 gameplay boundary 바깥으로 넘지 않는다.

diamond_motes.construction: 45도 회전된 diamond mote. procedural mask 또는 shared atlas mask 사용.

directional_slash_sdf.construction: directional slash 형태를 analytic SDF/boolean union-subtract로 생성한다. edge width는 world-space로 유지하고 fwidth로 AA한다.

dual_parallel_lines.construction: 진행 축 양쪽의 평행 line pair. Width는 world-space이며 join은 miter, sharp turn은 bevel fallback.

exact_circle_ring.construction: exact circle ring 형태를 analytic SDF/boolean union-subtract로 생성한다. edge width는 world-space로 유지하고 fwidth로 AA한다.

exact_hitbox_ring.construction: exact hitbox ring 형태를 analytic SDF/boolean union-subtract로 생성한다. edge width는 world-space로 유지하고 fwidth로 AA한다.

expanding_ring_sdf.construction: expanding ring 형태를 analytic SDF/boolean union-subtract로 생성한다. edge width는 world-space로 유지하고 fwidth로 AA한다.

half_res_sphere_volume.construction: sphere/ellipsoid bounded local raymarch volume. Scene depth에서 terminate한다.

hex_constellation_sdf.construction: hex constellation 형태를 analytic SDF/boolean union-subtract로 생성한다. edge width는 world-space로 유지하고 fwidth로 AA한다.

large_signature_sdf.construction: large signature 형태를 analytic SDF/boolean union-subtract로 생성한다. edge width는 world-space로 유지하고 fwidth로 AA한다.

low_frequency_fill.construction: 큰 soft fill sprite; 디테일이 아니라 body volume 보강용. procedural mask 또는 shared atlas mask 사용.

polar_rune_sdf.construction: polar rune 형태를 analytic SDF/boolean union-subtract로 생성한다. edge width는 world-space로 유지하고 fwidth로 AA한다.

radial_energy.construction: 중심에서 바깥으로 방사되는 energy disc/rays; fwidth AA와 analytic radial mask 사용.

radial_shock.construction: 빠르게 팽창하는 shock ring/disc; fwidth AA와 analytic radial mask 사용.

radial_slash_sdf.construction: radial slash 형태를 analytic SDF/boolean union-subtract로 생성한다. edge width는 world-space로 유지하고 fwidth로 AA한다.

radial_ticks_sdf.construction: radial ticks 형태를 analytic SDF/boolean union-subtract로 생성한다. edge width는 world-space로 유지하고 fwidth로 AA한다.

screen_space_radial_normal.construction: 화면 중심/impact 방향에서 방사형 normal/distortion field. UI에는 적용하지 않는다.

shard_mesh.construction: 비대칭 결정 파편; local +Z가 장축/진행 방향. mesh atlas에서 선택하며 단순 octahedron으로 대체하지 않는다.

short_arc_ribbon.construction: 짧은 2D/3D arc를 따라가는 tapered ribbon. Width는 world-space이며 join은 miter, sharp turn은 bevel fallback.

short_bezier_to_player.construction: source→player의 짧은 quadratic/cubic bezier. Width는 world-space이며 join은 miter, sharp turn은 bevel fallback.

small_motes.construction: 작은 원형/점광성 mote. procedural mask 또는 shared atlas mask 사용.

small_pulse.construction: 짧게 팽창/감쇠하는 작은 disc/ring pulse; fwidth AA와 analytic radial mask 사용.

small_shards.construction: 작은 날카로운 2D shard. procedural mask 또는 shared atlas mask 사용.

small_star_ring.construction: 작은 4~6 point star 중심 + 얇은 outer ring을 union. star tip은 방향을 갖지 않는 대칭형이며 fwidth AA 사용.

soft_disc.construction: 중앙이 밝고 가장자리로 부드럽게 사라지는 disc; fwidth AA와 analytic radial mask 사용.

soft_disc_noise.construction: soft disc에 저주파 noise로 edge breakup; fwidth AA와 analytic radial mask 사용.

soft_motes.construction: soft-edge 원형 mote. procedural mask 또는 shared atlas mask 사용.

status_symbol_sdf.construction: status symbol 형태를 analytic SDF/boolean union-subtract로 생성한다. edge width는 world-space로 유지하고 fwidth로 AA한다.

velocity_billboard.construction: 장축이 velocity에 정렬되고 면은 camera를 향하는 stretched billboard. procedural mask 또는 shared atlas mask 사용.

voronoi_crack_decal.construction: Voronoi cell edge에서 일부 branch만 선택한 균열 decal. center에서 바깥으로 crack density가 감소한다.

warped_flame_disc.construction: disc 기반 flame body; vertical/domain warp로 flame tongue 형성; fwidth AA와 analytic radial mask 사용.

smoke_billboard_6way.construction: camera-facing soft-depth billboard. coverage/lighting comes from 6-way smoke flipbook; exact gameplay boundary를 표현하지 않는다.

organic_ground_decal.construction: authored organic decal mask projected to ground/surface; never authoritative gameplay geometry.

schema: each effect input_mode is event_stream or persistent_snapshot
every VisualElement.source.type resolves to source_type_contracts and its backend resolves to source_backend_registry
every source/output parameter exists in its scoped parameter schema; parameter metadata resolves through schemas.parameter_catalog
unknown visual element/source/output fields fail cooking
legacy aliases never emit simultaneously with replacement
render profile shader_contract and phase references resolve
one source may feed multiple outputs and cooker must not duplicate source simulation state per output
gameplay: binding must_match_logic=true이면 gameplay.authoritative가 1개 이상 존재하고 해당 element output은 low quality에서도 남아야 한다
authoritative geometry는 typed gameplay payload의 radius/width/range/angle/lifetime을 직접 사용한다
persistent danger visual은 snapshot record가 사라지는 프레임에 gameplay 의미를 종료한다
directional gameplay effects pass 8-direction frozen-frame readability
secondary output removal must never change perceived hitbox boundary
visual: primary read is recognizable at normal gameplay camera
protanopia/deuteranopia simulation preserves state distinction by shape
same-effect x8 and boss+player+pickup overlap stress keep priority ordering
impact/release frame is the brightness/shape peak; dissipation is never brighter
bloom does not widen gameplay boundary enough to change perceived hitbox
distortion never affects UI and never hides telegraph edge
performance: do not allocate stateful GPU storage when age+seed can reconstruct motion
local volume is high-tier hero-only and pooled
VFX light list is capped by screen size and importance
component count is minimized by sharing simulation for multiple outputs
low quality disables secondary particles/volume/light before primary gameplay-read components
temporal: fast/large translucent components write profile-defined motion vectors or reactive coverage
spawn/despawn does not leave visible history trails
distortion and high-emissive changes contribute to reactive mask
volume history rejects at depth discontinuities

gameplay-authoritative geometry는 texture/flipbook이 없어도 동일한 boundary/silhouette/timing으로 유지되어야 한다.

mesh_emissive_oit baseline은 2D authored detail mask를 사용하지 않는다.
local_volume은 boss hero allowlist 외 effect에서 금지한다.
STBN은 spatial 및 temporal low-frequency suppression QA를 모두 통과해야 한다.

data texture의 sRGB import는 cook error다.

texture_asset_contract.goal: Runtime/context-compressed production contract. All effect recipes, shader/render contracts, texture runtime semantics, channel/slice maps, gameplay-authoritative geometry and quality rules are preserved. Source-generation files, historical migration records and QA snapshots are intentionally omitted.
principles: 판정 반경/경계/방향처럼 gameplay truth를 전달하는 circle, ring, sector, cone, lane, projectile silhouette는 analytic SDF/mesh가 source of truth다.
hand-painted slash, blood-like splash, relic ornament, organic residue처럼 예술적 불규칙성이 중요한 detail은 authored texture array를 사용한다.
복잡한 FBM/Worley/curl/volume density는 매 픽셀 고비용 procedural 계산보다 shared data texture lookup을 우선한다.
일반 smoke/explosion body는 baked 6-way lighting flipbook을 사용하고, raymarched local volume은 hero boss effect에만 제한한다.
색상은 가능한 한 texture에 bake하지 않고 style palette/gradient/HDR parameter에서 적용한다.
authoring data texture는 linear/signed-linear로 취급하며 sRGB import를 금지한다.
texture가 실패하거나 quality tier에서 제거되어도 gameplay-authoritative geometry는 남아야 한다.
